KruxSYS

Krunk is a KruxSYS product: a fast, private browser for Windows, with a preview for Android. Open source (MIT), no telemetry.

Bundles Chromium through the Chromium Embedded Framework, and filter lists by EasyList and uBlock Origin; see the notices in the download.
